newsitem.title: USA: Minn. ends fiscal 1997 with $302 mln rev surplus.
newsitem.headline: Minn. ends fiscal 1997 with $302 mln rev surplus.

text.p: Minnesota Gov. Arne Carlson announced Tuesday that the state closed fiscal 1997 with a $302 million surplus.
Carlson said the surplus reflects a "vigorous state economy" and said that a strong year in the agricultural sector made a major contribution to personal income growth in Minnesota.
Carlson plans to meet with Standard & Poor's officials in New York this week to seek restoration of a AAA bond rating from the agency.
Minnesota has received top ratings from both Moody's Investors Service and Fitch Investors Service, Carlson noted.
While much of the surplus has been allocated, it could open the door to one-time tax reductions of up to $100 million, Carlson said.
